summary.headline: 1 removed, 2 changed
glance: This update has **1 removed**, **2 changed** (1 substantive, 1 minor, 0 editorial, 0 mapping-only).
`SDR-CSX-KMT` Key Security Indicator Metrics: Normative keywords changed: MAY, MUST×3 → MAY, MUST×2, SHOULD.
`SDR-CSX-KMT` Key Security Indicator Metrics: Class B obligation level changed from **MUST** to **SHOULD** (weaker requirement).
Removed rule `FRC-CSX-MOT` Metrics Over Time for Key Security Indicators.

removed.name: Metrics Over Time for Key Security Indicators
removed.text:
Class A: Providers seeking 20x Class A Certification MAY supply historical metrics for Key Security Indicators.
Class B: Providers seeking 20x Class B Certification SHOULD supply historical metrics for Key Security Indicators.
Class C: Providers seeking 20x Class C Certification MUST supply historical metrics including status from persistent validation over at least the past 6 months for all Key Security Indicators.
Class D: Providers seeking 20x Class D Certification MUST provide historical metrics including status from persistent validation over at least the past 18 months for all Key Security Indicators.
fedramp_notes: 2026-06-24: Official launch of the FedRAMP Consolidated Rules for 2026.
